description: The minimal, explicit permission surface of the main window (BR-37). core:default is the Tauri core baseline (window/event/webview basics) and nothing else — the demo exposes no commands and touches no OS API. Every ADDITIONAL permission must also be added to ALLOWED_PERMISSIONS in scripts/shell-verify.mjs (a gate edit) and recorded in an ADR: the diff a review sees is the diff the attack surface grows by.
